```{r ,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=7,fig.width=12, out.width="100%"}

# ======================================================
# SES histogram + clustered family-level heatmap
# Pollinator + plant species counts in labels
# ======================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

alpha <- 0.05
critical_value <- qnorm(0.975)
top_n_plants <- 18

cat_levels <- c("Avoidance", "No difference", "Preference")
cat_labels <- c("Avoidance", "No difference", "Preference")

plot_cols <- c(
  "Avoidance" = "#F1A340",
  "No difference" = "grey85",
  "Preference" = "#7B3294"
)

poll_order <- c("Hymenoptera", "Diptera", "Coleoptera", "Lepidoptera")

# -----------------------------
# Load data
# -----------------------------

SES_genus <- readRDS("../Data/Working_files/SES_genus.rds")

SES_family <- readRDS("../Data/Working_files/SES.rds")
pval_df_family <- readRDS("../Data/Working_files/pval_df.rds")

raw_data <- readRDS("../Data/Working_files/interaction_data.rds")

# -----------------------------
# Count pollinator species per family
# -----------------------------

pollinator_family_n_species <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Pollinator_accepted_name),
    Pollinator_rank == "SPECIES",
    Pollinator_order %in% poll_order,
    !is.na(Pollinator_family)
  ) %>%
  distinct(Pollinator_family, Pollinator_accepted_name) %>%
  count(Pollinator_family, name = "n_species")

# -----------------------------
# Count plant species per family
# -----------------------------

plant_n_species <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Plant_family),
    !is.na(Plant_accepted_name)
  ) %>%
  distinct(Plant_family, Plant_accepted_name) %>%
  count(Plant_family, name = "n_species")

# ======================================================
# A) SES histogram
# ======================================================

SES_df <- as.data.frame(SES_genus) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Plant_family") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -Plant_family,
    names_to = "Pollinator_genus",
    values_to = "SES"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SES)) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      SES < -critical_value ~ "Avoidance",
      SES >  critical_value ~ "Preference",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    ),
    category = factor(category, levels = cat_levels)
  )

x_lim <- quantile(abs(SES_df$SES), 0.85, na.rm = TRUE)

p_ses <- ggplot(SES_df, aes(x = SES, fill = category)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 1100,
    alpha = 0.9,
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2,
    position = "identity"
  ) +
  ggtitle("a)") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-critical_value, critical_value),
    linetype = "longdash",
    colour = "grey35"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#3B3B3B") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = plot_cols, guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-x_lim, x_lim), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardized effect size (SES)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(size = 1.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1)
  )

# ======================================================
# B) Family-level heatmap data
# ======================================================

heat_df <- as.data.frame(SES_family) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Plant_family") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -Plant_family,
    names_to = "Pollinator_family",
    values_to = "SES"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    pval_df_family,
    by = c("Plant_family", "Pollinator_family")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SES)) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      p_two < alpha & SES > 0 ~ "Preference",
      p_two < alpha & SES < 0 ~ "Avoidance",
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    ),
    category = factor(category, levels = cat_levels)
  )

# Keep plant families with strongest signal
plant_keep <- heat_df %>%
  group_by(Plant_family) %>%
  summarise(signal = sum(abs(SES), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(signal, n = top_n_plants) %>%
  pull(Plant_family)

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  filter(Plant_family %in% plant_keep)

# Matrix for clustering
ses_mat <- heat_df %>%
  select(Plant_family, Pollinator_family, SES) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Pollinator_family,
    values_from = SES,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Plant_family") %>%
  as.matrix()

plant_order <- rownames(ses_mat)[hclust(dist(ses_mat))$order]

pollinator_order <- colnames(ses_mat)[hclust(dist(t(ses_mat)))$order]

# Labels with species richness
plant_labels <- plant_n_species %>%
  filter(Plant_family %in% plant_order) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(Plant_family, " (", n_species, ")")) %>%
  select(Plant_family, label) %>%
  deframe()

pollinator_labels <- pollinator_family_n_species %>%
  filter(Pollinator_family %in% pollinator_order) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(Pollinator_family, " (", n_species, ")")) %>%
  select(Pollinator_family, label) %>%
  deframe()

heat_df <- heat_df %>%
  mutate(
    Plant_family = factor(
      Plant_family,
      levels = plant_order,
      labels = plant_labels[plant_order]
    ),
    Pollinator_family = factor(
      Pollinator_family,
      levels = rev(pollinator_order),
      labels = rev(pollinator_labels[pollinator_order])
    )
  )

# ======================================================
# C) Family-level heatmap
# ======================================================

p_heat <- ggplot(
  heat_df,
  aes(x = Plant_family, y = Pollinator_family, fill = category)
) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = plot_cols, name = "Observed against null") +
  labs(
    x = "Plant family",
    y = "Pollinator family"
  ) +
  ggtitle("b)") +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = 11),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
  )

# ======================================================
# D) Shared legend
# ======================================================

legend_plot <- ggplot(
  data.frame(category = factor(cat_levels, levels = cat_levels)),
  aes(x = category, fill = category)
) +
  geom_bar(alpha = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = plot_cols,
    breaks = cat_levels,
    labels = cat_labels,
    name = "Observed against null",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      override.aes = list(alpha = 1)
    )
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = "white"),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 1.5),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 4, r = 6, b = 6, l = 6),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 2, 0)
  )

# ======================================================
# E) Combined plot
# ======================================================

p_ses_noleg <- p_ses +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  guides(fill = "none")

p_heat_noleg <- p_heat +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  guides(fill = "none")

plots_row <- plot_grid(
  p_ses_noleg,
  p_heat_noleg,
  ncol = 2,
  align = "h",
  axis = "tb",
  rel_widths = c(1, 1.4)
)

plots_row <- plots_row +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = -20, l = 0))

combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  plots_row,
  legend_plot,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.18)
)

combined_plot
```
